canary_semantics: positive changes one named hidden coordinate; canary keeps it fixed (clock canary changes raw direction to verify discrimination)
claim: Occupancy/bulk shadows are incomplete across six independent interaction families; the named hidden coordinate changes the fresh response.
falsifier: any positive lacks predicted divergence or any identical-coordinate canary diverges
fresh_world_rule: OS-entropy seed; admissible N/geometry/range fixed by challenge generator
metric: exact family predicate; no fitted tolerance
prediction: direction, payload, semantic, guard geometry, phase/history and ordered lineage each yield predicted divergence; identical-coordinate canary does not
scope: fresh admissible worlds in six frozen mechanism classes
threshold: all three fresh trials and their paired canaries pass
